title: Keycloak: MariaDB Connector/J is used to connect applications developed in Java to MariaDB and MySQL databases…
description: A security vulnerability exists in the Keycloak package affecting versions prior to 26.8.1-r1. The issue involves the MariaDB Connector/J used for connecting Java applications to MariaDB and MySQL databases. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 5.9, indicating a medium severity level, and impacts availability without affecting confidentiality or integrity. A patch is available in version 26.8.1-r1 to address this issue.
